Description: Thank you for your interest in applying for the Rancher Resilience Grant. This grant is designed to support cattle producers' attendance at impactful educational events. It is made possible by a partnership between the National Cattlemen's Foundation and Cargill Protein and is administered by the National Cattlemen's Beef Association.

Title: Sustainability Fund Grant | SustainableUMD
Description: Proposals are due by October 15th or January 15th, each year. The minimum grant request is $2,001 for fund grants. If you would like to request less than that amount, apply for a Sustainability Mini-Grant.

Title: Adaptation Planning Grant Program - Office of Land Use and Climate Innovation
Description: The program provides flexible funding to meet multi-sector/issue planning needs that intersect with climate risks, including but not limited to land use, transportation, economic, housing, natural resource management, public infrastructure, and hazard mitigation issues.
